name: What other home modifications should I consider alongside walker accessible doorways?

mainEntity.name: What other home modifications should I consider alongside walker accessible doorways?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alongside walker accessible doorways, other beneficial home modifications for mobility include installing grab bars in bathrooms, replacing high-pile carpets with low-pile or hard flooring, adding ramps for exterior steps, and converting showers to curbless or roll-in designs. Improving lighting, lowering countertop heights, and installing lever-style door handles can also enhance overall home accessibility and safety for individuals using walkers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider grab bars, low-pile flooring, ramps, curbless showers, better lighting, and lever handles to complement walker accessible doorways.
